title: Himawari extension statement
description: extensions/<name>.schema.json: the signature of an extension statement (rfcs/0007, spec/language.md §2.7). The game's runtime implements it in C with hw_register_statement(). Core enforces more than this schema: the name must match the file name and not be a keyword, and at most one parameter may be text.

name.description: The statement's name, as written in scripts: name(args).

description.description: Shown on hover in Studio and to AI assistants.

blocking.description: The story waits until the extension says it's done.

enum.description: For type word: the allowed words.
